limitations: Run only after the active measurement batch; hashes read every retained evidence file.
Manifest hashes establish retained file integrity, not independent correctness or causal proof.
Observer timing uses pipe chunk arrival and can include buffering; it is not native request TTFT.
Lifecycle counter differences omit work before first and after last available sample.
Sampled memory maxima are lower bounds on true peaks; GPU counters and request CPU/I/O attribution remain unknown.
Do not sum overlapping phase, worker, supervisor and tool spans or call cumulative startup reads decode-critical I/O.
